video_title: God Shammgod on Training Young Kobe, Kyrie Irving’s Handles & Playing With Ron Artest In High School

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on Ron Artest's high school reputation
quotes.excerpt: Ron was actively crazy but wasn't crazy in high school.
quotes.quote: You know what's so crazy about Ron? Ron was actively crazy but wasn't crazy in high school. So that's why when Ron got in the NBA, people were like, 'Yo, you know Ron tough and he crazy.' I'm like, 'Ron? Like, no man.' I used to have to go snatch Ron by his jersey. Like, 'Come on man, get over here, what you doing man?' Because Ron was two years younger than me. I'm like, 'Man, come sit down man, what are you doing, bro?' Because coach would be like, 'Man, go get Ron.' I'm like, 'Ron, sit down.'
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod recalls Ron Artest in high school: He was not the crazy guy people saw in the NBA. I used to have to snatch him by his jersey and tell him to sit down because he was just a kid.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on Ron Artest's development and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: Ron was like he wasn't the NBA but less. He always worked hard.
quotes.quote: When Ron first came to La Salle, Ron was like he wasn't the NBA but less. Like, he didn't do nothing really good, nothing really exceptional. He always worked hard, but he really couldn't dribble at this time, he really couldn't shoot at this time. But he would see me come to the gym every morning at 6:00 and workout. And then me and him would work out and do stuff. I would talk to him about stuff, and then he always had massive heart. So I would be like, 'Oh, come on Ron, I got you.' So he just became my little brother for real.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod on Ron Artest's early development: He was not exceptional at first, he could not really dribble or shoot, but he had massive heart and worked hard to become my little brother for real.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on Tom Konchalski's influence on basketball analytics
quotes.excerpt: Tom Konchalski, rest in peace. He was analytics before analytics.
quotes.quote: Everybody know, I mean, people out there don't know, but y'all know who Tom Konchalski is. Tom Konchalski, rest in peace. He was analytics before analytics. So my opening, my senior year, I wasn't up for McDonald's. So me and Steph hanging out and Steph ranked number one, and I always be like, 'Man, how is this nigga number one and I ain't even top 20?' I'm with him every day and I'm saying to myself like, 'Yeah, I believe he number one.' But I'm like, 'Man, he can't guard me.'
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod remembers Tom Konchalski as the original analytics guy before analytics existed. He also reflects on his high school rivalry with Stephon Marbury.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on playing against Kobe Bryant in high school
quotes.excerpt: We play in the tournament up there, we play against Kobe up there.
quotes.quote: We go to Rhode Island tournament. This when I first committed to Providence. And we playing in the tournament up there, we play against Kobe up there. And Kobe, I'm telling him, I'm like, 'Yo,' I'm like, 'Yo,' because Kobe played with me at ABCD. And his father comes up to me and his father is like, 'Hey, can you show my son how to dribble?' And I was like, 'Okay, whatever.' Like, a lot of people always ask me to show somebody how to dribble, so I'm like, 'Okay, cool.' So we play a game, and like I said, I just got announced to be McDonald's. So I'm like, 'Yeah, this my team.' We get on the court, this dude is shooting. I didn't know who he is. This when he first came, I'm like, 'Who is this dude shooting all the balls?' This is my show. And he like shooting all the balls, talking like Jordan, walking like Jordan. And you know how kids be. We like, 'Man, who this nigga think he is? He think he Jordan, bro?'
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod on meeting a young Kobe Bryant: He was shooting all the balls and acting like Michael Jordan. We were all looking at him like who does this guy think he is?
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on Kobe Bryant's father asking for dribbling lessons
quotes.excerpt: His pops come up to me, never forget, rest in peace, his pops come up to me.
quotes.quote: His pops come up to me, never forget, rest in peace, his pops come up to me and he's like, 'Yo, man, your handle is so crazy. Can you show my son? Like, he can do everything, but he really can't dribble like that.' So I'm like, 'All right.' I'm like, 'Who your son?' And he point to Kobe. I'm like, 'This dude? Hell no. He shooting the ball all the time. No way.' So I'm like, 'Hell no.' I'm like, 'Never do anything with him, bro. No way.'
quotes.social_post: Joe Bryant once asked God Shammgod to teach a young Kobe how to dribble. Shammgod's initial reaction? Hell no. He thought Kobe was just a ball hog.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady

quotes.speaker: God Shammgod
quotes.summary_phrase: God Shammgod on training with Tim Thomas in high school
quotes.excerpt: Every day I used to get up in the morning before Cam, ABCD and do some stuff.
quotes.quote: He like, 'Nah, can you show him?' So I'm like, 'All right.' So like every day I used to get up in the morning before Cam, ABCD and do some stuff. So I was like, 'Yeah, I'll be in the gym like 5:00. If you want to come, he can come.' Like, I'm just being smart. Like, no way I'm going to be in the gym 5:00 in the morning. I'm like, 'Yeah, if you want to come, come.' So I get there my normal time like 7:00. He in a full-blown sweat. This is high school. This is high school. Yeah, I mean, going into 12th, he going to 11th. Because at this time, Tim Thomas is all world. Kobe is not even, Tim Thomas is everything. Tim Thomas is everything. Right. Yeah, and me and Tim Thomas already played against each other because we played them in the high school scrimmage game. He was playing the point guard. So I'm like, 'Yo, Tim crazy.' So I'm like, 'There's no, I'm like, there's nobody next to Tim.' Like, at this point, Tim was like everything, man-child.
quotes.social_post: God Shammgod recalls Kobe Bryant's work ethic in high school. Shammgod told Kobe to meet him at 5 AM expecting him not to show up, but Kobe was already in a full sweat when Shammgod arrived.
quotes.team: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady
